description: Sequential switch stepping through the channels of a polyphonic input and putting one of them out at a time

params.text: Picks the order: forwards, backwards, pendulum, a random walk one channel either way, or a random channel each clock

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on to the next channel, in the order set by the Dir switch
A rising edge returns to the first channel and blocks the clock for 1ms
The polyphonic cable that is stepped through; its channel count sets the length of the sequence

outputs.text: The voltage of the channel the switch has reached, and 0V while nothing is patched into the input

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
